concerns.text: Task T001d states “CI step that fails if any skeleton directory is missing” but does not specify a concrete implementation (e.g., a test file or script) nor a verification artifact. Add a unit test or CI job (e.g., `tests/test_skeleton_ci.py::test_directories_present`) that asserts the directories exist during CI.

Task T005d “CI step that validates the workflow file structure” lacks a concrete deliverable (no script, test, or validation rule is named). Provide a validation script (e.g., `scripts/validate_ci_workflow.py`) and a corresponding CI test (`tests/test_ci_workflow.py`).

Task T009d “CI step that records runtime; fails only if explicitly configured to enforce limit” does not define how the runtime is recorded or which CI job checks it. Add a concrete CI job (e.g., `runtime-check` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`) and a test script that asserts the runtime is captured and compared to the threshold.

Task T012e “Global seed propagation: ensure `--seed` is passed to all stochastic modules” mentions a unit test but does not name the test file or the exact verification steps. Define a test (e.g., `tests/unit/test_seed_propagation.py`) that checks the seed is used in correlation, baseline, and negative‑sampling modules.

Task T013c “CI job invoking Reference‑Validator and aborting on non‑zero exit” lacks a concrete CI job definition or a test script. Add a CI job entry (e.g., `reference-validator-ci`) and a corresponding test (`tests/integration/test_reference_validator_ci.py`).

Task T013d “Extend citation validation to enforce title‑token overlap ≥ 0.7” does not specify a test or verification artifact. Provide a unit test (e.g., `tests/unit/test_citation_overlap.py`) that checks the overlap metric.

Task T098 (logger extension) – “parallel flag removed” is a note rather than an actionable deliverable. Either remove this entry or replace it with a concrete task (e.g., update `src/utils/logger.py` to drop the parallel flag).
Task T098d claims “Unit test for logger extension (already present)” but does not reference a specific test file. Cite the exact test (e.g., `tests/unit/test_logger_extension.py`).

Task T099 “CI test for CLI validator – unchanged” provides no concrete CI job or test file. Add a CI job entry (e.g., `threshold-validator-ci`) and a test script (`tests/integration/test_cli_validator_ci.py`).

Task T100 “CI step for citation validation – unchanged” lacks a concrete CI job definition. Define a CI job (e.g., `citation-validator-ci`) and a test script (`tests/integration/test_citation_validator_ci.py`).
Task T098c mentions a unit test but does not name the test file. Specify the test file (e.g., `tests/unit/test_logger_fields.py`).
Task T099c references a CI step executing T012c unit test but does not provide the CI job name or script. Add a CI job (e.g., `cli-threshold-ci`) that runs `pytest tests/unit/test_cli_threshold.py`.

Task T100c mentions a CI job invoking Reference‑Validator but does not give the job name or script. Define a CI job (e.g., `reference-validator-ci`) that runs the validator script and fails on non‑zero exit.

Task T011c “Run verification script after every Make target (FR‑017)” does not specify how this is enforced (e.g., a wrapper script or a Makefile rule). Provide a concrete implementation detail, such as adding a `post-validate` target that calls `src/pipeline/validate.py`.
Task T012e is marked with a tilde (~) indicating it is in progress, but no verification artifact is listed. Add a unit test file and mark the task as completed when the test passes.
Task T013c is also marked with a tilde and lacks a concrete test artifact. Define a test file and update the task status when the test passes.
Task T013d is marked with a tilde and missing a concrete verification step. Provide a test file and update the task status accordingly.
This entry is a comment rather than an actionable task; it should be removed or turned into a concrete task with a deliverable and verification.
